title: Beatrix and the Prom
author: Odile Sterling
blurb: Ulyana Montrose, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
